description: Defines command strategies for policy persistence actor in the Eclipse Ditto project. Implements a singleton class that registers various strategy objects for handling different policy-related commands, such as create, modify, retrieve, and delete, at multiple levels (policy, entries, subjects, resources, sudo).

classes.name: PolicyCommandStrategies
classes.description: Singleton class that manages and registers command strategies related to policies, implementing the logic for various policy command handling strategies.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PolicyCommandStrategies.

methods.name: getCreatePolicyStrategy
methods.description: Returns the command strategy used for creating policies.
